subject: Portal proof canonicalization + presign window coordination
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@clearsky.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: portal-admin@onetrust.com
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding — initial evidence mapping

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the onboarding help. We're starting the OneTrust profile for ClearSky and want to align the evidence fields with Redwood's SOC2/SIG expectations before we bulk upload. Two quick asks from our security ops lead:

- Can you confirm a canonical list of evidence fields you expect as SSOT (single source of truth)? We currently have vendor-specific field names that will need normalization.
- What's your preferred presign/curl flow for S3 uploads? Our pipeline creates presigned URLs but the default TTL is 72 hours — can Redwood accept shorter windows?

I've attached our current field mapping spreadsheet (clearsky_proof_field_map_v1.xlsx) for reference. If helpful we can do a short call to walk through.

Sara Patel
Security Operations
ClearSky Systems

Attachment: clearsky_proof_field_map_v1.xlsx (xlsx spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@clearsky.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding — initial evidence mapping

Sara — thanks for the spreadsheet, that helps. Short answers up front: 1) yes, we prefer a compact canonical field set (SSOT) for each evidentiary item; 2) 24-hour presign TTLs are our default for automated ingest, but we can accept 48-hour for initial bulk-stage windows if you need it.

Proposal / next steps:
- I'll attach a small mapping template (see redwood_soc2-sig-compact_matrix.csv) using our canonical column names: evidence_id, control_family, control_id, artifact_type, s3_path_hint, owner, retention_ttl_days, accepted_formats.
- If ClearSky can populate s3_path_hint and owner columns we can generate a presign manifest that your pipeline consumes.
- For the bulk run: request a 48-hour presign window for the staging upload; we will ingest and snapshot proofs to our bucket, then hand back manifest hashes.

One open question for your team: do you plan to use ephemeral service accounts vs. long-lived service keys for the upload? Ephemeral (short-lived) creds are preferred for traceability.

I can do a 30 minute sync tomorrow 9:30-10:00 PT or 2:00-2:30 PT — which works best?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Security Integrations (Vendor Portal Lead)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2-sig-compact_matrix.csv (CSV, 8KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara@clearsky.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding — initial evidence mapping

Looping in a couple of practical constraints we've seen:

- Canonicalization: please map any "policy_doc" or "ctl_doc" fields to 'artifact_type:policy' and normalize date formats to ISO-8601 in the s3_path_hint. That drastically reduces manual QA.
- Retention/TTL: retention_ttl_days should reflect the shortest required retention across the control family (e.g., SOC2: 365 days default; if your legal/regulatory requires longer please flag it).
- Presign windows: 24h is ideal, 48h acceptable for initial staging; anything above that requires explicit uplift and an export snapshot with owner attestations.

On the credentialing side — if ClearSky will use ephemeral service accounts, we need the presumed STS/assume-role ARN or the OAuth client id so we can add it to our ingestion allowlist.

Sidenote: quoting Sara's earlier note —

> We've attached our current field mapping spreadsheet (clearsky_proof_field_map_v1.xlsx).

Sara, if you can update the s3_path_hint and owner columns in the attached matrix and re-send, we will produce the presign manifest and share the upload endpoints. Also confirm whether you want us to pre-calculate the evidence hashes (md5/sha256) on our side or if you'll provide them before upload.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Patel <sara@clearsky.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: portal-admin@onetrust.com
Date: 2026-08-19T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal onboarding — initial evidence mapping

Thanks Logan and Marissa — that all sounds good.

We will:
- Update clearsky_proof_field_map_v1.xlsx with s3_path_hint and owner (expected by EOD PT today).
- Switch our pipeline to request 48h presigns for the bulk staging window this first run.
- Use ephemeral upload credentials (STS assume-role); I'll share the ARN and OAuth client id in a separate secure message to portal-admin@onetrust.com.
- Provide pre-calculated sha256 hashes for artifacts where feasible; otherwise we'll rely on Redwood to snapshot and return hashes.

Call: 2026-08-19 09:30 PT works for us for a 30-min sync — I've added a calendar invite.

Sara Patel
Security Operations
ClearSky Systems

Attachment: clearsky_proof_field_map_v1.xlsx (updated; 44KB)
